name: Multiplicative Clear-Sky Bound
asymptotic_horizon_behavior: Enforces U -> 0 as elev -> 0. Fails completely in low-sun.
causal_availability: YES (Astronomical / MEPS Clear-Sky GHI available at origin)
identifiability: Direct geometric model, but unphysical near horizon.

name: Clear-Sky + Positive Floor
asymptotic_horizon_behavior: Maintains positive floor as elev -> 0. Eliminates horizon collapse.
causal_availability: YES (Causal floor independent of forecast horizon)
identifiability: Formulation supported; numeric constant (80 W/m²) uncalibrated from sensor physics.
scientific_defensibility: FORMULATION-SUPPORTED: Decouples diffuse background from direct beam.

name: Elevation-Aware Continuous Envelope
asymptotic_horizon_behavior: Continuous decay from horizon diffuse envelope into direct beam regime.
causal_availability: YES (Solar elevation is purely astronomical and known causally)
identifiability: Formulation supported; functional parameters require direct/diffuse sensor data.

name: Empirical Historical Regime Envelope
asymptotic_horizon_behavior: Step-function empirical upper quantile based on training data.
identifiability: Purely statistical/empirical; lacks physical radiative transfer basis.
scientific_defensibility: INSUFFICIENT: Step-function artifacts, lacks physical grounding.
